<!-- pr-reviewer: c2a31dc46c593602a12a1d68b238bfd493aa4e1b -->
Needs changes before merge.

The count helper gives the correct singular and plural forms. The status strip still hides the count for zero operations. The new structural test checks both forms through the shell harness and an operation command. I found no code defect in this change.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `7f2d9bfc4efe40dbf12e06c93f2675896814925b`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui` | 1204 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored |
| New status count test | Passed in the library suite |
| `boundary` | 3 passed |
| `boundary_picks` | 7 passed |
| `sinker_setup` | 2 passed |
| `tap_hand` | 3 passed |
| `theme_example` | 3 passed |
| `theme_files` | 17 passed |
| `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

I stopped the first gate planner build after it made no progress with sccache. The planner and all checks completed with the wrapper disabled. The planner included changes from upstream in the pending merge. I selected the UI suites from this PR's diff instead. No GitHub runner ran.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:1628`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for this visible UI change. Show the status strip with one operation before and after the fix. Store the images only on your fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not add them to this PR branch or change the snapshot PNGs. The current body has no screenshots and says no visual check ran.

Notes:

- This change does not affect posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. No safety mutations were required. No golden files changed.
- The existing `structural.rs` file exceeds 400 lines. This PR adds three lines to register a separate test module. This is not a blocker.
- I checked the laws from the current upstream/main `AGENTS.md`. The new module has a provenance comment. No dependency or process file changed.
- I did not launch the GUI or run the ignored pixel snapshot tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

I added the before and after screenshots to the PR body (section "Screenshots"). They show the status strip with one operation: "1 Operations" before, "1 Operation" after. The images are on the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch of my fork (`sn3ro/Camcraft`). This branch and the snapshot PNGs did not change.

The head is still c2a31dc46. I made no push to this branch. It is ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c2a31dc46c593602a12a1d68b238bfd493aa4e1b -->
Re-review of the same head. Clean. The open request is met.

The earlier review on this head asked for one change: before/after screenshots of the status strip with one operation. This review checks that request only, and confirms that nothing else changed.

Request 1 (screenshots), result: met.

- The PR body has a "Screenshots" section with a before/after table.
- "Before" shows the right end of the status strip with the text "1 Operations".
- "After" shows the same strip with the text "1 Operation".
- The two crops are 880 x 52 px, from the same frame. Only the count label is different.
- The full frames are also linked.
- The images are on the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch of `sn3ro/Camcraft`. That branch holds only `README.md` and `2594/*.png`.
- The PR branch does not contain the images. No snapshot PNG changed.

Other checks:

- The head is still `c2a31dc46c593602a12a1d68b238bfd493aa4e1b`. The PR has one commit. The author made no push after the earlier review.
- The changed files are the same four files: `browser_tree.rs`, `panes.rs`, `tests/structural.rs`, `tests/structural/ops_count.rs`.
- A trial merge with upstream/main at `5fdbed9bd8e7a8bb28e6f162a02ab423842b77e8` is clean, with no conflicts. GitHub reports MERGEABLE.
- On the merged tree, all helpers that the new test uses still exist: `painted`, `shell_harness`, `snapshot_guard`, `model::find_by_name`, `model::operation_of`, `CommandKind::CreateOperation`, `drain_actions`.
- On the merged tree, `panes.rs` line 1634 calls `browser_tree::count(ops_n, "Operation")`. The label shows only when `ops_n > 0`.

Build and tests:

- The earlier review on this head built the PR merged with upstream/main `7f2d9bfc4`. `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` gave 1204 passed, 0 failed. The seven UI suites and clippy passed.
- For this re-review, the local build on the new merge did not complete. The compiler stopped making progress on the first dependency crates in this session, with and without sccache. This build is "not built". It is not a pass.
- upstream/main changed many files in `crates/ui` since `7f2d9bfc4`. The merge of this PR is textually clean. The post-merge gate will run the UI lib suite on `main`.

Extra suites run: none required. The diff changes no file under `testdata/`, no fixture or golden directory, and no import code.

Safety tier: no. This change does not affect posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. No mutations were required.

Laws: checked against the current upstream/main `AGENTS.md`. No dependency, process file, script or workflow changed. The new module has a provenance comment. The `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2340` are present.

The earlier request on this head ends with this review. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The maintainer gave the order to merge this PR. Merge class: SAME (no commit after the reviewed head). The merge relies on the re-review by mkinney with the marker for head `c2a31dc46c593602a12a1d68b238bfd493aa4e1b`.
